name: Inu ni Natta Boku to H Suru Onna-tachi
original_name: 犬になった僕とHする女達
source:
A shonen with an inferiority complex is transformed into a dog by a goddess.
Suddenly girls are all over him. He wasn't cute as a human, but as a puppy he gets
tons of tail. A cute classmate, his homeroom teacher and his own mother!?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ106942.html]DLsite English[/url]]
